استحقيت (form X)
# اِسْتَحَقَّيْتُ (istaḥaqqaytu) /is.ta.ħaq.qaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَحَقَّ (istaḥaqqa)
# اِسْتَحَقَّيْتَ (istaḥaqqayta) /is.ta.ħaq.qaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَحَقَّ (istaḥaqqa)
# اِسْتَحَقَّيْتِ (istaḥaqqayti) /is.ta.ħaq.qaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَحَقَّ (istaḥaqqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
